topic: How do GEO vs LEO satellite orbits affect latency and coverage in hybrid networks for rural substation monitoring?
consensus_response: GEO satellites offer broad coverage with high latency, while LEO satellites provide lower latency with added complexity. Combining both orbits balances trade-offs but increases system complexity. Atmospheric conditions impact signal propagation, and technologies like Adaptive Coding and Modulation (ACM) enhance link reliability.
reference_context: Satellite orbits affect latency and coverage, with GEO having higher delays and LEO offering lower latency but increased complexity, impacting rural substation monitoring.
